استجرنا (form X)
# اِسْتَجَرْنَا (istajarnā) /is.ta.d͡ʒar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَجَارَ (istajāra)
# اُسْتُجِرْنَا (ustujirnā) /us.tu.d͡ʒir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَجَارَ (istajāra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
